title: What Kaidra AI is
text: Kaidra AI provides 24/7 AI agents that engage customers instantly across WhatsApp, Instagram, Web chat, and SMS. It boosts bookings, enhances retention, and automates day-to-day operations for service businesses. Kaidra's tagline is 'Scale Conversations. Grow Revenue.'

title: Who Kaidra is for
text: Kaidra is built for businesses in the fitness, beauty, wellness, and healthcare sectors - including fitness studios, gyms, salons, spas, clinics, and physiotherapy or rehabilitation centres. While it's marketed heavily toward fitness studios, its Terms of Service explicitly cover this broader range of service businesses.

title: Channels Kaidra supports
text: Kaidra engages customers across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, SMS, and Web chat - all from one unified system.

title: Kaidra's three AI agents
text: Kaidra provides three AI agents that work together: (1) Lead Conversion & Growth Agent - engages new leads instantly, answers questions, books appointments 24/7, and nurtures trial users with reminders and follow-ups. (2) Retention & Upsell Agent - identifies at-risk clients early, re-engages them with targeted messages to prevent churn, and recommends relevant upgrades. (3) Support & Staff Copilot - handles FAQs, scheduling, and daily support tasks while giving staff instant access to client notes and insights.

title: Integrations
text: Kaidra integrates with Mindbody, Glofox, Hapana, Zapier, Calendly, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Stripe - unifying bookings, payments, scheduling, and messaging in one place.

title: Pricing
text: Kaidra doesn't publish pricing or plan tiers on its website - pricing is sales-led. After a demo/discovery conversation, a business receives a specific Order Confirmation with its fees. There's no self-serve pricing page.

title: Getting started / onboarding process
text: Kaidra's onboarding has 3 steps: (1) Onboard & Explore - meet the onboarding team, share business details, and try 'Agent Lab' (a sandbox to preview how your AI agent responds) before going live. (2) Connect & Configure - Kaidra integrates your CRM, lead sources, WhatsApp, and other channels, then configures the agent to your workflows; you then get trial access. (3) Go Live & Scale - after a successful trial, you activate your subscription and Kaidra handles engagement, follow-ups, and conversations around the clock. No technical skills are required - the onboarding team handles setup.

title: Results and stats
text: Kaidra responds in under 3 seconds, 24/7. Businesses typically see about 38% less operational load as the AI handles FAQs, follow-ups, and trial bookings. Most businesses see positive ROI within 30 days. Client testimonials cite booking-rate increases of up to 40%.

title: Client testimonials and brands
text: Kaidra is used by studios and wellness brands including Club Revive, FTI, BFT, F45, and Anytime Fitness. Testimonial highlights: Anytime Fitness - 'Kaidra increased our booking rate by 40% in the first month. It's like having our best receptionist working 24/7.' BFT - 'We went from missing late-night leads to converting them instantly.' F45 Training - 'Our coaches were overloaded with inquiries. Kaidra now handles first responses and follow-ups, letting our team focus on members.'

title: How Kaidra handles trust and AI accuracy
text: Kaidra discloses that its AI-generated responses may occasionally contain errors or incomplete information, and customers are asked to verify important information before acting on it. Customer data remains the customer business's own property, and is handled under Kaidra's PDPA-compliant privacy practices.

title: Data privacy and security
text: Kaidra follows Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA). It collects name, contact info, business details, payment info, login/profile data, technical data (IP/browser/OS), and AI interaction data - only as needed to provide the service. Data is retained per type: contact/identity data for 3 years after account termination, business/transaction data until termination or as legally required, payment data until subscription ends, and profile/usage data until account termination. Customers can access, correct, or request deletion of their data, and may file a complaint with Singapore's PDPC. Kaidra implements security measures and regular backups, and may use anonymised/aggregated data to improve the AI without identifying individuals. Cookies are used for site functionality and can be managed in browser settings.

title: Support hours and contact
text: Standard support is available 9:00 am - 5:00 pm, Monday to Friday, Singapore time, via email or phone. Scheduled maintenance is notified in advance where possible. Contact email: contact@kaidra.ai.

title: Billing terms
text: Invoices are payable within 7 days of issue. Late or failed payments may result in temporary suspension of access. Kaidra may adjust fees with 30 days' written notice. All taxes and transaction/gateway charges are the customer's responsibility.

title: Contract terms, liability, and termination
text: Either party may terminate the service with 60 days' written notice before renewal. Kaidra may suspend or terminate for non-payment beyond 30 days or material breach. After termination, customer data may be deleted or anonymised after 30 days unless legally required to be retained. Kaidra's direct liability is capped at SGD 2,000 per incident; indirect or consequential losses (like lost profit) are excluded, except for liability related to death, personal injury, or fraud, which is never limited. These Terms are governed by the laws of Singapore, and disputes go to arbitration via the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC).

title: Booking a demo / free trial
text: Visitors can book a demo through the contact form (Name, Email, Business Name, and Phone are required; Message is optional). The team responds within 24 to 48 hours. After onboarding and configuration, businesses receive trial access before activating a paid subscription - so yes, Kaidra does offer a trial period, just not a self-serve one; it's provided as part of the guided onboarding process.

title: FAQ: How is Kaidra different from a chatbot?
text: Generic bots miss conversations, forget follow-ups, and can't personalize retention. Kaidra is purpose-built to acquire, nurture, retain, and grow customers, combining instant 24/7 engagement with predictive retention insights and revenue-focused automation - not just scripted replies.
